title: Carrion insect
wikitext:
{{for|the notable passive skill|Carrion (passive skill)}}
A '''carrion insect''' is a type of [[beast]] [[monster]] found in and around [[Sarn]] and [[the Wetlands]]. Carrion insects have a distinct bulbous abdomen and swarm prey in large packs.

A '''carrion queen''' is a large species of carrion insect capable of spawning more carrion insects and firing projectiles.

__TOC__
